review:
Aztec Clusters is a 6x8 cluster slot that BGaming designed with the analytics platform Casinolytics, using insights from thousands of hours of casino streams to shape the pacing of its features. Five or more connected symbols form a win, and each win activates cell multipliers of up to 10x.

After a win, the Dig-up feature can randomly add sticky wilds, a Booster, a Destroyer or a scatter, so the board can change mid-spin. You can choose how to play: standard spins, Wild Spins, or a bonus buy in which sticky wilds carry multipliers up to 100x. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 10,000x maximum, and the 97% RTP is among the best in this database. Free spins land about once every 321 spins on average.
